prompts.walk-v2: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL animation sheet for exactly Lumine female Traveler from reference image. Blonde bob, white flowers, white blue gold dress, white boots, scarf. Natural slim human 6.5-head proportions. ONE silver straight sword held securely in RIGHT hand by the dark grip behind gold crossguard, blade lowered forward away from knees. Side view FACE RIGHT every frame. EIGHT full-body keyframes in TWO columns FOUR rows, read row-major. Every complete blade/body isolated in own cell with large transparent gutters; never touch neighboring figures. True transparent alpha; no scenery, shadow, labels, lines, effects or duplicates. Crisp SIMPLE limited-color pixel clusters. All eight figures have precisely the SAME anatomical scale, head size, sword length, body height and grounded floor baseline relative to each cell. This is a coherent LOOP, not eight random variations. Clearly alternate near/far legs and hands. Head stays stable; knees bend and straighten, hips rotate slightly, left arm counter-swings modestly, scarf lags naturally. Right hand maintains convincing sword grip. WALK FORWARD to RIGHT, modest combat walking speed, no running or hops. Exact sequence:1 right foot contacts ahead heel-first, left foot behind toe-off;2 weight settles on right bent knee, left heel lifts;3 left foot PASSES right ankle under hip with bent knee;4 left knee swings ahead, right foot rolls heel-up;5 LEFT foot contacts ahead heel-first, right foot behind toe-off (opposite leg contact to frame1);6 weight settles on LEFT bent knee, right heel lifts;7 RIGHT foot passes left ankle under hip;8 right knee swings ahead, left foot rolls heel-up, clean continuation into frame1. Torso and face remain angled right all eight. Two complete alternating steps. Scarf not rigid.
